title: The 5 Best Pressure Washers Under $150
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for pressure washers under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pressure washers under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3000 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2030 max PSI, 1.76 GPM max flow, Typically $130 to $150, Dual detergent tanks.
strengths: Dual detergent tanks are a genuine convenience rarely found on budget units
limitations: Sometimes prices closer to the top of this budget range depending on retailer promotions
Plastic housing and wheels feel less rugged than step-up premium models
No surface cleaner included for faster driveway coverage

products.name: Sun Joe SPX3001 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 2030 max PSI, 1.76 GPM max flow, 34-inch extension wand, Rear wheels for maneuverability.
strengths: Same core PSI and GPM as the SPX3000 with an added extension wand for reaching under decks, behind grills, and gutters
Rear wheels make it easier to reposition than carrying by the handle alone
Often priced a bit lower than the SPX3000 depending on retailer
limitations: Extension wand is a nice-to-have but not essential for most driveway or car-washing use
Shares the same plastic-housing durability tradeoffs as the SPX3000
Nearly identical spec sheet to the SPX3000 makes choosing between them mostly a matter of price at time of purchase

products.name: AR Blue Clean AR383 Electric Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1900 PSI, 1.51 GPM, Typically under $100, Bayonet-connect accessories.
strengths: 1900 PSI still covers cars, patios, and light driveway duty comfortably
Integrated hose reel is a tidier storage solution than loose coiled hose
limitations: Lower PSI and GPM than either Sun Joe model, slower on tougher jobs
Bayonet fittings limit compatibility with some aftermarket accessories

products.name: Greenworks GPW1501 1500 PSI Pressure Washer
products.blurb: Key specs: 1500 max PSI, 1.2 GPM, Typically $70 to $90, Upright hand-carry design.
strengths: Lightest and most compact, ideal for small jobs and easy storage
1500 PSI is gentle enough for wood decking and patio furniture without much technique needed
limitations: Lowest PSI and GPM of the four picks, not the right choice for a large driveway
Fewer included nozzles than the Sun Joe models
Best suited to small and medium jobs rather than heavy-duty use

products.name: RYOBI 2000 PSI 1.2 GPM Electric Pressure Washer
